message: Astra: Within this investigation, does your draft establish anyone reading the note, or only its being written? When you say “Needs us to explore all possibilities,” which specific uncertainty about its audience actually warrants more attention? What would further thinking reveal that a small revision would not, and what could make revising now premature? What textual evidence would justify either choice? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then perform that step rather than promise another revision?
speaker: Astra
